title: HDtracks
deck: A high-resolution music store, rebuilt from the ground up.
role: Director of marketing and lead designer
lede: HDtracks sells high-resolution music to people who care how a recording sounds. In 2019 the store was rebranded and rebuilt from the ground up, from the database to the logo, so a deep catalog reads as clearly as it sounds. Around it runs a year-round line of campaigns and email. Retention and sales rose.
challenge: HDtracks sells high-resolution music downloads to listeners who care how a recording sounds. In 2019 it took on a complete rebrand and a redesign of its website, which meant making a deep catalog easy to browse and the brand as clear as the audio.
work: The redesign started under the surface: a new website built from the ground up, with new database storage, then the UX and UI design, updated branding, logos and the ad campaigns.

The store shows albums in a clean grid, gives each one a page, and makes room for editorial features on classic recordings. Around it runs a steady line of email and campaigns, from VIP sales and Grammy winners to browsing by genre, New York Music Month and the storewide sale that opened 2021.
The rebrand and redesign increased customer retention and sales.
system: Email and ads around the year.
deliverables: Website, built from the ground up
credits: Dalton Corr: rebrand, website design, UX and UI, logos, campaigns
